rules.name: Pre-Screening Document Image Quality
rules.description: Image must possess adequate sharpness, contrast, and resolution without critical specular reflection.

rules.name: Multi-Signal Forensic Anomaly Limit
rules.description: Composite forensic anomaly score must remain within normal baseline limits.

rules.name: Face Embedding Verification Threshold
rules.description: Biometric cosine similarity between document photograph and live selfie must equal or exceed 0.65.

rules.name: Single Face Across Multiple Disparate Identities
rules.description: Biometric face signature must not correlate with previously recorded disparate synthetic identities.
